scope: Training-only categorical distribution and optimization-weight audit; no fitting or inference of a probability model

objects.population_weight: Original inverse inclusion weight attached to a sampled target cell-hour
objects.presence: At least one class-c pixel anywhere in the actual cropped input patch
objects.center_class: Class of the target cell at the patch center
objects.pixel_exposure_share: Inverse-weighted mean fraction of patch positions in class c; positions are counted repeatedly across overlapping target patches
objects.presence_frequency: Inverse-weighted probability that a sampled target input patch contains class c; category cohorts can overlap
objects.weighted_target_frequency: Inverse-weighted frequency that the target center first becomes newly burned at the next hourly snapshot among rows whose input patch contains class c
objects.optimization_weight: Original population weight multiplied by training-only normalized patch-presence rarity factor

helper_audit.presence_scope: Anywhere in each learner's actual raw cropped environmental patch
helper_audit.source_combination: Arithmetic mean of source factors; each source factor averages distinct present classes
limitations: Changes the training covariate distribution, rather than balancing outcomes
Presence groups overlap; this does not make every category equally frequent
Does not guarantee equal feature gradients, calibration, or improved held-out performance

Patch-presence category cohorts overlap and are not a disjoint partition.
Biome8 never occurs at a target center in this training cache; its observed support is neighboring input context.
Rarity weighting creates no independent samples and cannot repair one-row support.
Category reweighting changes finite-model optimization and does not guarantee calibration or better held-out performance.
Only observed training categories contribute fitted rarity factors; unobserved fixed vocabulary columns are neutral.

Category reweighting can change the marginal target frequency, because categorical inputs and outcomes are associated; even input-only weights do not guarantee calibration for a restricted constant/shared-rate model.
optimization_target_frequency_derivation: Independent recombination of saved pooled-row strata: original training mass in each target/contact/per-support presence stratum times its fitted input-only row factor. No validation/test labels used to fit the factor.

final_helper_source_revalidation.procedure: Recomputed the final helper on all five exact raw training cohorts using temporary memory-mapped fields and bounded 512-row copies. Entire fitted audits and output optimization-weight checksums match the original measurements exactly. Raw category distribution measurements retained because cache hashes and effective weights are unchanged.
